title: Pumpkin Spice Granola
changes_from_base: Pumpkin purée, brown sugar, oil and five warm spices coat oats, pumpkin seeds, pecans, flaxseed and milk powder, which bake slowly for 90 min; raisins and crystallised ginger go in once it has cooled.
summary: A warm-spiced granola built on pumpkin purée and seeds, enriched with toasted pecans and finished with sticky pieces of crystallised ginger and plump raisins.
equipment: large rimmed baking tray (about 33 x 46 cm)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 150 °C (130 °C fan) and cover a large rimmed baking tray with baking paper.

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: In a large bowl, mix 267 g rolled oats, 113 g pumpkin seeds, 110 g pecans diced, 35 g flaxseed and 28 g skimmed milk powder.

steps.title: Wet
steps.text: In a medium bowl, whisk together 227 g tinned pumpkin purée, 159 g light brown sugar, 110 ml vegetable oil, ⅓ tsp fine salt, ½ tsp ground cinnamon, ½ tsp ground ginger, ¼ tsp ground nutmeg, ¼ tsp ground allspice and a pinch of ground cloves until smooth.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Tip the wet ingredients over the dry and stir thoroughly until everything is evenly coated.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread on the tray and bake for about 90 min, stirring thoroughly every 15 min, until golden brown and nearly dry (it will crisp further as it cools).

steps.title: Add
steps.text: Once cooled, stir through 149 g raisins and 92 g crystallised ginger diced.

steps.title: Store
steps.text: Pack into an airtight jar for up to 2 weeks at room temperature, or freeze for 3 months.

tips: Stir the granola every 15 minutes to guarantee even browning and prevent burning at the edges
The pumpkin purée keeps this granola naturally moist, so stir often and bake long for thorough drying
Add the crystallised ginger and raisins after cooling to maintain their texture and prevent softening
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for 2 weeks, or freeze for up to 3 months. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
